description_en: Queries the available kernel versions for upgrade
description_zh: 查询可升级的内核版本
name: ListMiniEngineVersions

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the cloud product type. Valid values:
5: ApsaraDB RDS.
8: PolarDB.
27: PolarDBX2.

If you specify both ProductId and ProductCode, the values must correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh: 云产品类型标识。5：RDS；8：POLARDB；27：PolarDBX2。与 ProductCode 同时指定时应对应
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The code of the cloud product. Column encryption supports RDS, POLARDB, and PolarDBX2. If you also specify ProductId, the two values must correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The instance identity of the database. You can obtain this value from Items[].InstanceId returned by the ListDataMaskingInstances operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例标识，可从 ListDataMaskingInstances 的 Items[].InstanceId 获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response description. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

KernelVersions.description_en: The list of available kernel versions
KernelVersions.description_zh: 可选择的内核版本列表

KernelReleaseType.description_en: The release type of the kernel version. This value is the same as the value returned by the corresponding database product. For example, for ApsaraDB RDS, LTS indicates a long-term support version and BETA indicates a preview version. For PolarDB, the value can be Stable, Old, HighRisk, or Beta
KernelReleaseType.description_zh: 内核版本的发布类型，沿用对应数据库产品的返回值。例如 RDS 的 LTS 表示长期支持版、BETA 表示预览版；PolarDB 可能返回 Stable、Old、HighRisk 或 Beta

KernelVersionName.description_en: The display name of the kernel version

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate the API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用
